title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.5 (Peaked November 09, 2026 at 19:49 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 649 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Things are moving pretty quickly out there. 🌬🌞👀

A prominent active region and sunspot group are visible near the center of the solar disk today.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
